blocks.text: 1. OPTICAL ILLUSION SUSPENDED IN THE SKY - Herein is certainly an incredible picture, A Mirage on the Horizon! - The cold seas off north Germany are ideal territory for mirages; such as this one of buildings. • Mirages form where light is refracted as it passes from hot air to cooler, denser air above it, or from cold air up into hotter air. MOONBOW: At night the full moon cast a golden arc (rainbow) across Cumberland Falls in Kentucky. It's the only moonbow ever in the Northern Hemisphere, as this picture illustrates. SOLOR-POWERED CAR I said that men would travel by light four decades ago! And now in space the sunlight hits the certain satellites powering them. But most remarkable, they can run a solar car by sunlight, as you can see in this photo of a prototype solar car of the future LASER BEAMS from rangefinders fan out near Parkfield, CA (above), in a seismic test to monitor activity along the San Andreas Fault. – Despite all they do the great earthquake will occur. Part of California will fall into the sea! COMPUTING WITH LIGHT – (Above) Rather than electrons, an optical computer trades in photons. Processing takes place in a slab of special glass, data is stored in some kind of holographic memory device, and information is passed between the two on laser beams. The machine would be unimaginably fast. CELESTIAL PHENOMENON – (Above) Unidentified objects are now seen in every nation. Luke 21:11, “and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.” – Ezekiel 28 speaks of Lucifer as the covering cherub. Ezekiel Chap. 1 speaks of God’s cherubim’s. “And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning!” (Verse 14) Also read Ps. 18:8-14 and Isa. 66:15. “THE LAST FORCE OF NATURE is the strong force, which binds protons and neutrons tightly together in atomic nuclei. In an atomic bomb the strong force is overcome and fragments of each nucleus are blasted apart by electric repulsion.” – According to the Script’s prophecy, newer energy and different type weapons are being worked on now!
